What it represents: Tenant-wide Fabric governance and settings
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric
Logging and auditing coverage: Supported administrative and tenant-setting operations.
Additional execution / operational evide: Use the published operation catalogue to define coverage. Collect through Purview and supported audit APIs; do not treat an operation catalogue as proof of enabled end-to-end collection.

What it represents: Compute allocation serving Fabric workspaces
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric; Fabric Capacity Metrics app
Logging and auditing coverage: Supported capacity administration; utilisation and throttling metrics.
Additional execution / operational evide: Use Capacity Metrics for performance/cost evidence. These metrics do not establish which records a user accessed.

What it represents: Container for Fabric items and collaboration
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric
Logging and auditing coverage: Workspace lifecycle and role operations.
Additional execution / operational evide: Recommended correlation: preserve workspace ID, capacity ID, tenant and actor. Enabling workspace monitoring is separate from collecting tenant audit events.

What it represents: Governance grouping for business data
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric
Logging and auditing coverage: Domain creation, modification and deletion.
Additional execution / operational evide: Recommended evidence: correlate domain changes with workspace membership and ownership; domain assignment is not a data-access log.

What it represents: Roles and grants controlling item access
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric; engine-specific security audit
Logging and auditing coverage: Supported role, sharing and access-role changes.
Additional execution / operational evide: Validate effective access across workspace roles, item grants, OneLake and SQL permissions. Entra group changes require Entra audit evidence.

What it represents: File and storage operations underlying Fabric data
Primary audit source: OneLake diagnostics
Logging and auditing coverage: Workspace-level JSON access logs written to a lakehouse in the same capacity.
Additional execution / operational evide: Enable separately. UI and Blob/ADLS API operations are logged; workload access records temporary access grants, requiring engine logs for detail. Purview alone is incomplete for storage activity.

What it represents: Reference to internal or external data
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric; OneLake diagnostics; external-source logs
Logging and auditing coverage: Shortcut configuration and supported data-access evidence.
Additional execution / operational evide: Cross-workspace access is recorded in the source workspace. Collect external storage logs for external-source operations; a shortcut audit event does not prove complete underlying file-read coverage.

What it represents: Sharing Fabric data across organisational boundaries
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric; OneLake diagnostics
Logging and auditing coverage: Supported share creation, invitation and acceptance operations.
Additional execution / operational evide: Recommended correlation: share ID, sender/recipient, affected item and later storage activity. Sharing configuration does not prove data consumption.

What it represents: Combined table and file storage item
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric; OneLake diagnostics; workload logs
Logging and auditing coverage: Item operations plus separately configured storage and execution evidence.
Additional execution / operational evide: Use SQL auditing for SQL endpoint access and Spark logs for Spark execution. Recommended correlation: item ID, path/table, job ID and identity.

What it represents: Analytical SQL warehouse
Primary audit source: Fabric SQL audit logs; Purview; Query Insights
Logging and auditing coverage: Configured SQL authentication, access, schema and security events.
Additional execution / operational evide: SQL auditing is off by default; select events/actions and filters. Audit files are stored in OneLake and can be queried with sys.fn_get_audit_file_v2. Export independently if logs must survive item deletion.

What it represents: SQL query interface over Fabric data
Primary audit source: Fabric SQL audit logs; Query Insights
Logging and auditing coverage: Configured endpoint SQL audit events and query execution history.
Additional execution / operational evide: Separate SQL evidence from OneLake/Spark access. Query Insights retains user-context query history for 30 days and is performance evidence, not a substitute for SQL auditing.

What it represents: Transactional SQL database hosted in Fabric
Primary audit source: Fabric SQL database auditing
Logging and auditing coverage: Selected database activity written to the OneLake Audit/sqldbauditlogs folder.
Additional execution / operational evide: Enable Save Events to SQL Audit Logs and set event/retention/filter scope. Query via T-SQL audit functions. Item deletion also removes its logs; auditing must be re-enabled after restore.

What it represents: Orchestration of ingestion and transformation activities
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric; pipeline run history; workspace monitoring
Logging and auditing coverage: Item operations; pipeline and activity execution outcomes.
Additional execution / operational evide: Enable workspace monitoring. Query ItemJobEventLogs and FabricDataPipelinesActivityRunsLogs for run identifiers, status, duration and failures. These records do not enumerate every source row read.

What it represents: Managed data movement between source and destination
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric; workspace monitoring
Logging and auditing coverage: Item operations and per-mapping copy execution detail.
Additional execution / operational evide: CopyJobActivityRunDetailsLogs records source-to-destination table/object mappings. Correlate with source database/storage auditing when record access matters.

What it represents: Power Query-based transformation and refresh
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric; refresh history; workspace monitoring
Logging and auditing coverage: Item operations and refresh/publish results.
Additional execution / operational evide: ItemJobEventLogs records refresh/publish status, duration and failures. Download detailed refresh logs where available for troubleshooting.

What it represents: Code-driven analysis, transformation or machine learning execution
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric; Spark application/driver/executor logs
Logging and auditing coverage: Supported notebook/item operations and execution diagnostics.
Additional execution / operational evide: Use notebook monitoring, Spark application details and Spark UI. Retain code/version and run identity; add explicit application logging for business-level outcomes.

What it represents: Replicated data from an external database or system
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric; mirrored database operation logs
Logging and auditing coverage: Item operations plus table-level replication execution logs.
Additional execution / operational evide: Monitor replication state, failures and lag. Source authentication, reads and source-side changes need source-system evidence; replication health is not a complete source audit.

What it represents: Real-time analytics storage and query engine
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric; Eventhouse workspace monitoring
Logging and auditing coverage: Queries, commands, ingestion, data operations and performance telemetry where supported.
Additional execution / operational evide: Enable supported monitoring tables. Validate current versus legacy monitoring coverage before claiming data-operation audit completeness.

What it represents: Streaming ingestion and transformation graph
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric; Eventstream runtime logs and monitoring
Logging and auditing coverage: Item operations; throughput, node status and error metrics.
Additional execution / operational evide: Enable workspace monitoring and Log Eventstream activity per item. Preview monitoring tables provide metrics/error counts, not detailed diagnostic messages; use runtime logs for additional troubleshooting.

What it represents: Rules that react to data conditions
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric; supported workspace monitoring
Logging and auditing coverage: Supported item operations and rule-notification telemetry.
Additional execution / operational evide: Validate rule-notification tables for the deployed experience. Recommended correlation: rule, trigger and downstream action; notification telemetry alone does not prove downstream delivery.

What it represents: Analytical model serving reports and clients
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric; semantic model operation logs
Logging and auditing coverage: Supported model activity and engine operations.
Additional execution / operational evide: Use workspace monitoring operation logs for engine health, performance and usage. Correlate refresh/query evidence with source logs; model queries are not equivalent to every underlying storage read.

What it represents: User-facing analytics and distribution objects
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric; Power BI activity log
Logging and auditing coverage: Supported viewing, sharing, publishing and export activities.
Additional execution / operational evide: ActivityEvents API retrieval is limited to the previous 28 days with each request bounded to one UTC day; follow continuation tokens. Export regularly and avoid duplicate counting across audit sources.

What it represents: Configured identity and route to an external system
Example instance: ERP SQL connection via Finance gateway
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric; gateway and destination logs
Logging and auditing coverage: Supported connection/gateway administrative activity.
Additional execution / operational evide: Correlate refresh/copy errors and source authentication with connection identity. Configuration evidence does not establish every downstream query or secret retrieval.

What it represents: Customer-operated bridge to private data sources
Primary audit source: Gateway service logs; host telemetry; Purview where supported
Logging and auditing coverage: Information, error and network service logs.
Additional execution / operational evide: Export through gateway Diagnostics and collect host security logs separately. Configure log rotation and retention; do not assume host logs are sent to Purview.

What it represents: Promotion and versioning of Fabric items
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric; repository / deployment records
Logging and auditing coverage: Supported deployment and integration activity.
Additional execution / operational evide: Recommended supplemental evidence: commit, approver, deployment result and item version. Fabric audit events do not replace Azure DevOps/GitHub repository auditing.

What it represents: Optional collection of supported workload telemetry
Primary audit source: Fabric monitoring database (preview)
Logging and auditing coverage: Supported workload logs and metrics collected after enablement.
Additional execution / operational evide: Data collection starts off and does not backfill. Query with KQL; default retention is 30 days. Verify workload/table support and retention separately from Purview and OneLake diagnostics.

What it represents: Configuration governing evidence generation and preservation
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview Audit — Fabric; SQL audit configuration; collection health checks
Logging and auditing coverage: Supported diagnostic-setting changes, including ModifyOneLakeDiagnosticSettings.
Additional execution / operational evide: Recommended checks: confirm known-event arrival in each destination and alert on collection gaps. Moving a workspace between capacities disables OneLake diagnostics until reconfigured.

What it represents: Authentication by users, applications and managed identities
Primary audit source: Microsoft Entra sign-in and audit logs
Logging and auditing coverage: User, service-principal and managed-identity authentication evidence.
Additional execution / operational evide: Collect the appropriate Entra log types separately. Correlate identities with Fabric operations; each Fabric request does not necessarily create a new sign-in event.
